Name: Ruchir Mahajan ; Email: ruchirmahajan2711@gmail.com Phone Number: 7507777509 ; Location: Gurugram

Profile Summary

BFSI professional with over 11 years of experience, including 6+ years as a project manager, delivering



enterprise transformation, regulatory reporting and strategic change initiatives. Strong expertise in project management, project governance, stakeholder & RAID management and project financials.

Experienced in Agile, SAFe and Hybrid delivery models, driving end-to-end programme execution, risk mitigation and executive reporting.

Managed GBP 3.7M–9.5M programmes for global organisations including Barclays Bank, leading cross-

functional teams across UK, US and Europe.

Delivered Basel IV, enterprise transformation and regulatory reporting initiatives, partnering with Finance, Risk, Compliance and Technology stakeholders.

Education Bachelor of Technology – Mechanical Engineering, Punjab Technical University (2010 – 2014)

Certifications

Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) • • Agile SAFe (In progress) • BCS-ISEB (Business Analyst)

Lean Six Sigma

Professional Experience

Project Manager – EXL Services (Client : Barclays Bank UK | Mar 2025 – May 2026)

Key Projects: End-to-end modernisation of trade booking platform — legacy decommissioning, system enhancement and operational transition.

Responsibilities held:

End-to-End Programme Ownership: Project managed the transformation of trade booking capabilities, owning delivery roadmaps, planning and resource management across business and tech teams using Agile and SAFe methodologies across JIRA and Confluence.

Risk & Dependency Management: Identified and resolved critical programme risks and cross-team dependencies — protecting key milestones, maintaining delivery momentum and preserving stakeholder confidence.

Governance & Financial Tracking: Ran overall project governance and financial tracking, setting up status



reporting and metrics used for executive decision-making. Legacy Decommissioning: Delivered a complex legacy decommissioning project, accelerating the original roadmap by 20% to enable efficient transition to newer systems.

1

Project Manager – IBM (Client : Barclays Bank UK | Aug 2021 – Mar 2025)

Key Projects:

Basel IV regulatory transformation — driving compliance across Business, Risk and Technology. • Accelerate Close Days programme delivery — reducing financial close cycle timelines for daily and monthly reports across finance and technology teams.

Responsibilities held:

Regulatory Programme Delivery: Owned end-to-end delivery for regulatory change for Basel IV and Accelerate Close Days — managing scope, budget and stakeholder alignment across Business, Risk and Technology, contributing to 19% cost reduction on a GBP 9.5M programme.

Delivery Governance: Drove milestone adherence from 72% to 91% through disciplined RAID tracking, risk ownership and dependency resolution.

Stakeholder Management: Influenced and aligned senior stakeholders across Business, Risk, Compliance and Technology — navigating conflicting priorities to maintain regulatory delivery momentum.

Programme Performance: Directed programme performance across multi-function, multi-geography teams — owning regulatory reporting, financial governance, budget tracking and benefit realisation aligned to strategic and compliance commitments.

Project Manager – NTT Data (Client : SEI Investments | Sept 2020 – Aug 2021)

Key Projects: Capital markets and investment programme support for SEI Investments — contributing to governance, stakeholder management and delivery execution.

Responsibilities held:

Programme Support & Governance: Supported delivery of capital markets and investment programmes across governance and stakeholder management.

Requirements Management: Reduced requirement rework by 30–35% through structured stakeholder workshops, improving business readiness and validation.

Agile Delivery: Improved backlog clarity enabling 15% faster release cycles across programme workstreams. • Traceability & Documentation: Owned FRD creation and requirements traceability from business need through to delivery acceptance.

Test Analyst and Business Analyst – Accenture (Client : Multi | Nov 2014 – Aug 2020)

Key Projects: PeopleSoft FSCM and HCM implementation for US Government, Canadian Government and Finland- based enterprise client across pension and insurance domains.

Responsibilities held:

Requirements & FRD: Led requirements analysis and FRD creation for PeopleSoft HCM and FSCM across pension and insurance platforms for US and Europe clients.

Quality & Testing: Reduced SIT defect leakage into UAT by 25–30% through improved traceability and validation frameworks.

Test Delivery: Supported SIT, UAT and regression cycles across structured waterfall and hybrid delivery programmes.

Domain Expertise: Delivered BFSI transformation across finance, pension, insurance and HR platforms for global clients.

2
